market_pulse.note: About $64,549 late Saturday afternoon, down about 6% over 24 hours (CoinGecko), after slipping below $65,000 for the first time since mid-August; it is down nearly 14% over seven days (Trending Topics; el7.ai).
About $1,781, down about 8.4% over 24 hours, with ether's share of total crypto market value at about 9.4% (CoinGecko).
About $2.30 trillion, down about 4.5% over 24 hours, with about $85.9 billion in 24-hour trading volume (CoinGecko).
About 56.3% of total crypto market value (CoinGecko).

themes.title: Bitcoin breaks below $65,000
themes.summary: Weekend selling pushed bitcoin under Friday's low of about $67,555 and then below $65,000, its weakest level since mid-August and about 49% below its October 2025 record near $126,000 (Bitcoin Magazine; Trending Topics).

themes.title: Below the 200-week average
themes.summary: Bitcoin has fallen under its 200-week moving average near $68,000; Trending Topics notes the mid-August close near $64,700 and the summer low near $58,600 as the next levels traders are watching (Trending Topics; Forbes).

themes.title: Fed hike bets and a firmer dollar
themes.summary: Hot October inflation data and Fed Governor Christopher Waller's support for a December hike have markets pricing a rate increase as nearly certain, while the dollar index sits above 103, its highest since April 2025 (Trending Topics).

themes.title: Liquidations and ETF outflows
themes.summary: About $1.01 billion in futures positions were liquidated over 24 hours, 93% of them long bets (CoinGlass, via Trending Topics); U.S. spot bitcoin ETFs had $1.07 billion of net outflows in the week through Friday, a seventh straight day of withdrawals (Farside; SoSoValue, via Trending Topics and CoinGape).

themes.title: Sentiment at extreme fear
themes.summary: The Crypto Fear & Greed Index fell to 13, a five-month low, from 20 on Friday and 28 on Thursday (CoinGape; Trending Topics).

categories.name: Majors (BTC/ETH)
categories.note: Bitcoin was down about 6% and ether about 8.4% over 24 hours late Saturday afternoon (CoinGecko).

categories.name: Large-cap altcoins
categories.note: BNB near $579 (-8.7%), XRP near $0.91 (-9.7%), Solana near $70 (-12.0%), Dogecoin near $0.057 (-11.9%) and Cardano near $0.147 (-13.6%) over 24 hours (CoinGecko).

categories.name: Small-cap gainers
categories.note: A handful of smaller tokens rose against the trend, including BOB (Build on Bitcoin), ni hao cat and AudaCity (CoinGecko).

categories.name: Derivatives and funds
categories.note: Leveraged long positions made up most of the roughly $1 billion in 24-hour liquidations, and bitcoin, ether, XRP and Solana ETFs all saw net outflows for the week (CoinGlass and Farside, via Trending Topics; CoinGape).

watch_list.why: Analysts are watching whether bitcoin can recover its 200-week average near $68,000 by the weekly close, or test lower levels near $64,700 and $58,600 (Forbes; Trending Topics).

watch_list.topic: ETF flows when U.S. markets reopen
watch_list.why: Spot bitcoin ETFs have recorded seven straight sessions of net outflows; flow data resume Monday (Trending Topics).

watch_list.topic: Nvidia earnings, Fed minutes and the Anthropic IPO
watch_list.why: Nvidia reports Tuesday, Fed minutes are due Wednesday and Anthropic's Nasdaq debut is expected Thursday, all watched for risk sentiment ahead of the December Fed meeting (Reuters via Yahoo Finance; Trending Topics).

movers.name: Cardano (ADA)
movers.note: About $0.147; the weakest of the large caps tracked (CoinGecko).
